headline: Meet the next wave of VCs judging Startup Battlefield 200 at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
context: Meet the next wave of VCs judging the Startup Battlefield 200 contenders on the main stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Register by September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT, to save up to $200 and to get a front-row seat to one of the most intense startup pitch competitions.
